scope: Pager desktop UUIDs, one/multiple desktop layouts, naming, navigation, button press/selection, wheel defaults, real window geometry and short-host popup sizing; private KWin/X11 only.

finding.previous_threshold: native popup height >= fractional QML implicitHeight - 0.5 px
finding.interpretation: Native Popup.Window geometry is integer-sized under this X11 test. The former half-pixel assertion classified a subpixel remainder as a clipped dialog. The revised check allows less than 1 px quantization and still fails if a whole pixel or more is missing.

implementation_change: Test assertion only; production DomainOSPager.qml hash is unchanged. No palette, desktop, or user configuration changed.
limits: This is a private X11/KWin integration run, not manual visual approval in the user session.
